name: Abraham Maldonado
title: Senior Software Engineer
summary: Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience building scalable enterprise platforms across healthcare, IoT, and SaaS. Skilled at architecting full stack applications with Python (Django, FastAPI), React.js, Next.js, and cloud infrastructure on AWS. Built products serving 2M+ users with 99.7% uptime and 12M+ daily API requests. Hands-on expertise in microservices, AI/ML integration with LangChain and LangGraph (RAG pipelines, automated workflows), real-time data pipelines, and CI/CD automation.

experience.title: Principal Software Engineer
experience.description: Built and maintained an enterprise AI platform with high uptime and scalable microservices architecture. Led migration to microservices and shipped AI-powered features.
achievements: Built and maintained an enterprise AI platform with 99.7% uptime using Python, Django, FastAPI, Next.js, PostgreSQL, and Pinecone across a distributed microservices architecture handling 12M+ daily requests.

Shipped AI-powered features using LangChain and LangGraph including automated contract analysis, RAG-based document search, and intelligent data extraction, reducing manual processing by 70% and lifting user engagement by 40%.

Led migration from a monolithic codebase to 12+ independent microservices with CI/CD pipelines on AWS and Docker, cutting deployment dependencies by 80% and reducing release cycles from hours to minutes.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
experience.description: Designed backend services and real-time analytics pipelines for a leading APM platform. Built dashboards and automated incident response tools.
achievements: Designed backend services in Python and Django powering real-time application monitoring, anomaly detection, and performance analytics for one of the leading APM platforms serving 50K+ tracked applications.
Engineered high-throughput data pipelines processing billions of metrics with Kafka, Redis, and PostgreSQL, driving real-time analytics and intelligent alerting with LLM-powered root cause analysis.
Built React.js and TypeScript dashboards with live trace visualization and automated incident response, cutting MTTR by 65% and improving application onboarding speed by 45%.

experience.title: Software Engineer
experience.description: Contributed to distributed analytics platform as a full-stack developer, building frontend and backend features for enterprise customers.
achievements: Contributed to the distributed analytics platform as a full-stack developer, building React.js components and Python/Django backend services for metrics collection, trace analysis, and custom dashboards across 100+ enterprise customers.

Built RESTful API endpoints and AI-powered chatbot with LangChain for natural language queries enabling developers to ask questions like 'show slowest endpoints' and receive interactive visualizations.
Supported development of Celery-based worker pipelines processing 100K+ events/second while collaborating with senior engineers on performance optimization and observability features.
